goal: Ordinary spontaneous Kyrgyz conversation/interviews/voice messages with publisher-supported human references; no training or tuning.
status: No qualified accessible corpus established among the inspected sources.
scope_limit: Bounded search result; not a universal absence claim. No read speech or machine-labelled material substituted. No inference was run on unqualified data.

sources.evidence: Card provides schema only. Independently read dataset_name, augmentation_type, snr columns of all three original parquet shards at fixed revision. All2700 rows derive from FLEURS and two studio/sentence datasets; only600original rows,2100augmentations.
sources.decision: Excluded: no established spontaneous conversation subset; cafe/phone metadata denotes augmentation, not natural environment.

sources.evidence: Publisher describes studio-quality sentence recordings, speaker Kanykey Bakashova, declarative/interrogative/exclamatory sentence categories.
sources.decision: Excluded: studio sentence corpus, no verified spontaneous conversational provenance.

sources.evidence: Publisher card provides sentence_type/speaker_id schema and1000rows but no recording-domain or human-transcription procedure.
sources.decision: Excluded: cannot infer spontaneous conversation or human-verification from card/name alone.

sources.evidence: Publisher restricts access/use to KSTU institution affiliates and rejects external requests. ASR-verified label is not itself proof of human conversation transcripts.
sources.decision: Excluded: restricted institution-only data; no access request or bypass; anonymous README resolution returned401.

sources.evidence: Card gives audio/transcript schema but no source/license/human-transcription provenance. Inspected100previewrows; expository sentences. Compared normalized references against prior1000FLEURS set: zero exact matches, so FLEURS derivation is NOT established.
sources.decision: Excluded for missing spontaneous/human-reference provenance, not on unproven FLEURS identification.

sources.name: M2ASR-Kirghiz
sources.evidence: Original research describes 128 hours / 163 speakers. Speakers read randomly prompted selected sentences, re-recording errors; this is prompted reading, not spontaneous conversation. Project resources are offered on request; project access failed in this check.

sources.name: Mozilla Common Voice catalog
sources.evidence: Current catalog includes Kyrgyz under Scripted Speech. Checked Spontaneous Speech listings/search returned no Kyrgyz dataset.
sources.decision: Scripted Kyrgyz excluded; no claim that no Kyrgyz spontaneous resource can exist elsewhere.

sources.name: Speech-data demo
sources.evidence: One37second female voice demo; transcript describes an AI voice dataset. No verified spontaneous/interview origin. CC BY-NC-ND4.0 card.

sources.name: Speechyou
sources.evidence: Provider claims a custom broadcast/podcast/interview dataset; inspected page offers transcription service, not downloadable human-reference corpus.
sources.decision: No public source acquired, no service upload or contact.

sources.name: Research interviews including Kyrgyz
sources.evidence: Author discusses recorded interviews and checked transcripts available at Bremen research center subject to respondent conditions. No unrestricted audio/transcript pair download established.
sources.decision: Not acquired; no request or privacy/access bypass.

sources.name: Nexdata public speech collection and conversation catalog
sources.evidence: Public service pages describe collection/annotation and customized conversation data, but inspected exact Kyrgyz/Kirghiz searches did not locate a direct conversational audio/reference demo. Anonymous HF API returned 23 Nexdata-kr repositories, none with Kyrgyz/Kirghiz in its name. This name-based inventory is not proof of absence in multilingual repositories.
sources.decision: No qualified public pair acquired; no contact or sample request sent.

sources.name: DataOcean public catalogs and HF demos
sources.evidence: Anonymous HF API returned 83 DataoceanAI repositories, none named Kyrgyz/Kirghiz. Chinese catalog search snippets explicitly recommend a Kyrgyz telephone conversation corpus (吉尔吉斯语识别语音库-对话（电话）); live page content and recommendation lists varied across reads. Inspected sample sections linked to consultation, not a downloadable audio/reference pair. Direct HTML fetch from local environment failed DNS resolution, so vendor availability is not comprehensively resolved.
sources.decision: Real vendor lead exists, but no public eligible demo established; no purchase, login, contact, or access bypass.

sources.name: Magic Data and MagicHub
sources.evidence: Public landing page advertises human-annotated duplex conversation data but Request Samples leads to contact form. Explorer browser rendering exposed no matching datasets. Bounded Kyrgyz/Kirghiz searches found no direct pair. Public spontaneous English sample is not Kyrgyz and was not substituted.
sources.decision: No qualified Kyrgyz public pair established; incomplete dynamic catalog visibility explicitly retained.

akylai_metadata_audit.method: HTTP range reads using fsspec and pyarrow, metadata columns only, all3shards; audio was not downloaded.
